subject: DPA & evidence cadence for Cedar Health — SCCs/UK Addendum + TIA scope
messages:
From: Michael Sanders <michael.sanders@cedarhealth.com>
To: naomi.feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cedarhealth.com, priya.rao@cedarhealth.com
Date: 2027-05-29T16:20:00-04:00
Subject: Intro + DPA / transfer evidence request

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Cedar Health liked the latency profile and the private deployment options. Procurement asked me to pull together the legal and technical items we need to close a PoC and make sure the DPA and transfer safeguards are covered.

Top asks from our side:
- A copy of Redwood's standard DPA with trackable changes (SCCs and UK Addendum references)
- Short write-up of where customer data may transit (CDN/edge regions) and whether any APAC or EU cache tiers are used for our US region workload
- TIA/DTIA scope summary for typical inference workloads (KV cache, logs, retention)
- A proposed evidence cadence (attachments requested, timelines) so procurement can schedule approval gates

I attached the RFI we use internally. Can your team confirm who on Redwood will own the evidence handoff and what DocuSign / procurement steps you prefer?

Regards,
Michael Sanders
Head of Procurement, Cedar Health

Attachment: Cedar_Procurement_RFI_20270529.pdf (pdf)
From: naomi.feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Michael Sanders <michael.sanders@cedarhealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, logan_wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + DPA / transfer evidence request

Hi Michael — great to meet you. Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below.

1) DPA: attaching Redwood_DPA_v1.2 (our current standard). Legal will accept a limited set of commercial redlines; for SCCs/UK Addendum we have a standard addendum that maps to the EU SCC 2021 clauses and the UK IDTA.

2) Data transit: for a US-hosted PoC we will keep inference serving in us-west-2 and do not route through EU/APAC caches by default. If you enable multi-region edge caching for lower latency, that will be an opt-in setting — we can lock that out in tenant config for Cedar.

3) TIA/DTIA scope: short summary attached (SCCs_and_UK_Addendum_Summary.xlsx) — shows token flows, what qualifies as customer content, and where KV cache snapshots are kept.

4) Evidence cadence: propose the following: initial DPA + SCCs signature, evidence package (SOC2 report stub, subprocessor list, dataflow diagram) within 7 business days, and a final technical onboarding call. Recommended owner: Kimberly Park (Legal ops) for DPA redlines and Logan Wright (Technical Ops) for evidence and network / cache confirmations.

Next: I’ll loop in Kimberly and Logan for redlines and a timeline. If you prefer DocuSign we can prepare the envelope and share a signing link once redlines are agreed.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Accounts — East
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v1.2.docx (docx); SCCs_and_UK_Addendum_Summary.xlsx (xlsx)
From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: naomi.feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, michael.sanders@cedarhealth.com
Cc: jordan.blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, logan.wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-31T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + DPA / transfer evidence request

Thanks Naomi / Michael — quick legal check-in.

Michael: I reviewed the RFI and Naomi's DPA. A few heads-up items we typically see as negotiation points for enterprise healthcare customers:
- Liability cap and indemnity carveouts tied to regulated data — we'll flag a limited adjustment and propose patient-data carveouts to the standard cap
- UK Addendum: we attach the standard UK IDTA; Cedar will need to confirm if they require additional UK residency commitments beyond the IDTA
- Subprocessor: we’ll provide the up-to-date subprocessor CSV and include a 30-day notice cadence for new subprocessors; for high-risk subs (e.g., logging/escrow) we can provide SOC2 excerpts on request

I'll prepare a redline (tracked) and aim to send by 2027-06-01 EOD. Logan, can you confirm the default region config and whether we can document an explicit org-level setting to disable cross-region edge caching for Cedar?

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Hi all — quick tech confirmation: default tenant placement for Cedar's PoC will be us-west-2 (in-region inference, no EU/APAC routing). We can add an organization-level flag that prevents edge caching outside us-west-2; that flag is applied during tenant provisioning and is persistently enforced by our control plane.

For evidence: I can provide (1) network flow diagram, (2) KV cache retention policy, (3) example logs redaction policy. I’ll upload these to the Drive folder Naomi created and aim to have them available by 2027-06-02 morning PST.

If procurement needs an on-record statement for SCCs/UK Addendum mapping, Kimberly and I can produce a short signed attestation describing which clauses are met by our controls.

— Logan Wright
Sr. Technical Program Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks Naomi, Kimberly, Logan — this is exactly what procurement needed. Two quick asks before we proceed to DocuSign: 

1) Can you confirm the evidence delivery timeline (you mentioned DPA redline by 6/1, and log/network artifacts by 6/2) — procurement needs firm dates to schedule approval gates.
2) Please add a short note in the Drive folder that Cedar requests explicit org-level lock for edge caching (we'll include that as a requirement in the SOW).

If both are confirmed, we'll proceed with DocuSign and expect to have internal legal review complete within 5 business days of receiving your redline.

Regards,
Michael
